description: This file contains asynchronous pytest-based tests for verifying OpenAI chat completions and OTEL spans retrieval, involving HTTP requests to a local server, and testing related functionalities such as key generation, chat completions, and trace span validation.

methods.name: generate_key( session, models=[ "gpt-4", "text-embedding-ada-002", "dall-e-2", "fake-openai-endpoint", "mistral-embed", ], )
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an API key by sending a POST request to a local server with specified models.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model: Union[str, List] = "gpt-4")
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request to a local server using a provided API key and model.

methods.name: get_otel_spans(session, key)
methods.description: Retrieves OpenTelemetry spans asynchronously from a local server using a provided API key.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_check_otel_spans()
methods.description: An asyncio test that creates a key, performs a chat completion, waits, then retrieves and verifies OTEL spans data.

ctags.name: chat_completion
ctags.pattern: /^async def chat_completion(session, key, model: Union[str, List] = "gpt-4"):$/
